Accomplishment

1. President of Taiwanese-America Seniors Association of Southern California (TASA)(南加州台灣人長輩會會長) 1995, 1997

2. One of the Founders of San Gabriel Taiwanese Lions Club (美國台灣人獅子會創辦人之一) 1993

3. Preparation and Publication fo the "California Daily" as the Managing Director (籌備與出版「加州日報」，出任常務董事)

5. General Manager of Liberty Times, California (加州自由時報總經理)
